demo_must_show: OAuth consent flow for Locality with all visible requested permissions expanded and readable.
Mounting Google Calendar and showing Locality enumerating existing primary-calendar events in the configured date window.
Opening a pulled event in Locality to show event metadata and content such as summary, time, location, attendees, description, and conference information are read.
Creating a Locality draft event with summary, start, end, timezone, optional location, attendees, description, and optional Google Meet conference.
Pushing the reviewed draft from Locality and showing the created event in the user's primary Google Calendar account with the same fields.
Stating that update and delete workflows are not exposed for Google Calendar V1 if the demo does not show them.
least_privilege_notes: calendar.events.owned is required because Locality reads existing events from the user's primary calendar and creates reviewed draft events on that primary calendar.
calendar.events is not requested because the connector is primary-calendar-only and does not operate on calendars the user does not own.
calendar.events.readonly and calendar.readonly are insufficient because Locality creates events.
calendar.app.created is insufficient because Locality must read existing primary-calendar events that were not created by Locality.
Full calendar, freebusy, settings, and readonly-only scopes are not requested by the runtime OAuth profile and must not be submitted for Google Calendar verification.
